name: Mariner 7
about: Mariner 7 (1969-030A, NASA/JPL), launched 1969 Mar 27. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.962 au and aphelion 1.577 au against GCAT's 0.963 and 1.568
